answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 7276 Country: India Title: Sunnate gair muakkada kitne rakate? Question: Sunnate gair muakkada kitne rakate? Answer ID: 7276 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1074/940=L/1429) The detail about Sunnah Ghiar Muakkadah is as follows: Four raka?at before Asr, Four raka?at before Isha, two or four raka?at after the Sunnah Muakkadah of Isha, likewise two or four raka?at after the Sunnah Muakkadah of Zuhr: ویستحب اربع قبل العصر و قبل العشاء و بعدھا بتسلیمۃ وان شاء رکعتین وکذا بعد الظھر و فی الشامی والظاھر ان الرکعتین المذکورتین غیر الموکدتین۔ ( شامی 2:452 ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
